definition: Admitted q selects the quality domain of a reading. It is not all predicates or all common names by definition. A Republic artifact reading and a Phaedo beautiful/good/large reading need distinct instantiations, not one silently universal domain.
note: Semantic interface for the bounded issue #257 readings. Primary passages motivate this sense but do not define this modern relational encoding. A sourced replacement would need a passage fixing precisely these semantic boundaries.
